text:
morgan: Heads-up — we're landing a platform change to consolidate multiple internal routing/quota headers into a single "x-rw-gate" header. This will affect SDKs (py/ts/go) and the console UX. Opening thread to align migration and rollout plan.

ingrid: quick q — what does the payload look like? base64 blob? json? size concerns?
morgan: payload is base64(json) to avoid weird header chars. small footprint, e.g. {"route":"/v1/generate","bucket":"team-A","sample":1}. encoded and sent as x-rw-gate.
kevin: can you paste a concrete example? easier for SDK folks to grok.
morgan: sure — example header: 
```
x-rw-gate: eyJyb3V0ZSI6Ii92MS9nZW5lcmF0ZSIsImJ1Y2tldCI6InRlYW0tQSIsInNhbXBsZSI6MX0=
```
SDK parsing psuedocode: 
```python
raw = resp.headers.get('x-rw-gate')
if raw:
    payload = json.loads(base64.b64decode(raw))
    route = payload.get('route')
    bucket = payload.get('bucket')
```

sam: main infra concern — some CDNs/proxies strip unknown headers. Do we have a fallback plan?
marina: console side — we need a new tile that breaks down gates by bucket+route, and a toggle to show legacy vs unified headers during opt-in. Also need telemetry events for gate decode failures.
morgan: good call. fallback plan: SDKs should still accept legacy headers (x-route-policy, x-quota-bucket) for a 30d overlap. We'll emit a telemetry event when both present and when decode fails.
kevin: SDK plan (draft):
- accept x-rw-gate if present
- fall back to legacy headers when gate absent
- expose `GateInfo` on response metadata for users
- deprecation warning logged once per process when legacy-only used after opt-in window

kevin: pseudo-TS API: 
```ts
const res = await client.request(...);
console.log(res.meta.gate?.bucket); // string | undefined
```

ingrid: any perf hit? base64 decode per request might add tiny CPU. batching decode in client lib possible but risky. maybe only decode when console/telemetry needs it?
marina: telemetry requirements: decode server-side into events too (gate.bucket, gate.route, decode_ok boolean) to avoid relying only on clients. Console will ingest those events to back the tile and time-series.
sam: security note: don't put PII in gate payload. Keep it to routing/quota metadata. We'll enforce schema validation at the gatekeeper.
dev-platform-bot: PR merged: platform/gatekeeper#802 — adds x-rw-gate encoding + schema validation (staging).
morgan: rollout proposal: 
- week 0: platform deploy + gatekeeper emits both legacy & x-rw-gate to callers in staging
- week 1-4: SDK opt-in releases (minor bumps) that prefer x-rw-gate but accept legacy; console tile in beta
- week 5: enable telemetry alerts for decode failures; opt-in window begins
- week 9: announce deprecation; require explicit opt-in flag in SDKs for legacy support
- week 12+: switch default to drop legacy support in SDKs, platform still emits legacy for an additional 2 weeks for edge cases

marina: for console UX, will prepare two quick mocks: (1) unified gate breakdown, (2) legacy vs detected header mismatch list. need telemetry field names asap.
kevin: I'll send SDK migration PRs today — py/ts/go. plan: add `meta.gate` field, and a flag env var `RW_GATE_LEGACY_FALLBACK=true` to control behavior during rollout.
ingrid: logging — please include failure reason string in telemetry (unknown_format / b64_error / schema_mismatch). Helps triage.
morgan: agreed. also add a lightweight health metric for decode success ratio.
kevin: will add to SDKs: emit analytics event `sdk.gate.decode` with tags {success, reason?, legacy_used}.
sam: I'll run a quick proxy test matrix to ensure common CDNs won't strip it. If we see stripping, we may need to move to an allowed header namespace or use body-level/response cookie fallback.
marina: thanks — this feels actionable. Anyone blocking SDK minor bump today?
kevin: no blockers. I have two follow-up items: (1) confirm exact schema in the platform PR, (2) decide opt-in flag semantics.
morgan: I'll update platform PR with schema and add the telemetry field list. pinging @ingrid for validation once done.
marina: I'll start console mockups.
ingrid: ok, will run schema validation tests tomorrow and post results here.
kevin: I'll post draft changelogs for py/ts/go after lunch.
marina: :thumbsup: 
kevin: thanks all — tagging this with the migration milestone.
